steps.name: Check direct file counts with the base gate
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
script="$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit.sh"
if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then
  cp scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh "$script"
else
  base="$(git rev-parse --verify "${BASE}^{commit}")"
  git ls-tree --name-only "$base" -- scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh >"$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit-base-path"
  if [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit-base-path" ]; then
    git show "$base:scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh" >"$script"
  else
    echo "base has no folder-limit gate; using PR copy for its first introduction" >&2
    cp scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh "$script"
  fi
fi
bash "$script"

gate.name: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' && 'CI gate' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && 'CI gate (main)' || 'CI gate') || format('CI gate ({0})', github.event_name) }}

steps.name: Every suite ran or the plan said it could be skipped
Pack the x86_64 rpm and check it
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s nullglob
debs=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/deb/epistle_*_amd64.deb)
if [ "${#debs[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "::error::expected one amd64 .deb, found ${#debs[@]}"
  exit 1
fi
version="$(basename "${debs[0]}")"
version="${version#epistle_}"
version="${version%_amd64.deb}"
echo "VERSION=$version" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
bash .github/scripts/distro_packages/pack-rpm.sh "${debs[0]}" "$version" x86_64 "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack"

steps.name: Pack an aarch64 header for the admission
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
bash .github/scripts/distro_packages/build-rpm.sh \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack/stage-x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack/out" "$VERSION" aarch64
bash tests/packaging/rpm/verify-rpm.sh \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack/out/epistle-${VERSION}-1.glyndor.any.aarch64.rpm" \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack/stage-x86_64" "$VERSION" aarch64
